submitted.rationale: The XRD shows the trirutile NiSb2O6-type phase from index 5 to 26. Index 11 (Ni 0.65) gave the highest measured EQE, 0.522%. The Sb-rich side does worse. At index 21 there is already a minor Sb-oxide second phase and EQE drops to 0.015%. By index 26 that second phase is strong. Going from Sb-rich toward Ni-rich, EQE rose from 0.015% (index 21) to 0.464% (index 16) to 0.522% (index 11). Index 11 has only trirutile peaks, while a NiO peak (Q about 2.96) first shows up at index 5. That places index 11 near the Ni-rich edge before a NiO phase forms.

rejected.reason: Close to the 1:2 NiSb2O6 ratio but already has an Sb-oxide second phase; EQE 0.015%.
Phase-pure trirutile but lower EQE (0.464%) than index 11.
Strong Sb-oxide secondary phase; the EQE trend on the Sb-rich side predicts poor performance.
A NiO secondary phase is starting to appear; no merit measurements were left to test it.
